text: Figure 5.6: AppOsTaskProxyToEcuTaskProxyMapping example Relation to TIMEX The Timing Extensions (TIMEX, see [7]) also offer a way to design the relative order of RTEEvents, which can be used as an alternative to Affinity Constraints. The two methods follow different approaches to scheduling: Affinity Constraints define an explicit order of elements via the offset attributes, while TIMEX defines an order as a chain of relationships between runnables or events. The former is similar to a fixed scheduling design, the latter similar to requirements that lead to a design. emplate
